mapper.sql: (SELECT count(recipes_to_categories.recipe_id) FROM recipes_to_categories WHERE recipes_to_categories.category_id = categories.id) AS recipe_count, categories.group_id, categories.id, categories.name, categories.slug, categories.created_at, categories.update_at
mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS recipe_count, categories.group_id, categories.id, categories.name, categories.slug, categories.created_at, categories.update_at FROM categories WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipes, recipes_to_categories WHERE categories.id = recipes_to_categories.category_id AND recipes.id = recipes_to_categories.recipe_id)) AND categories.group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (group_id, id, name, slug, created_at, update_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{id}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{createdAt}, #{updateAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM recipes r WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users owner WHERE owner.id = r.user_id AND owner.household_id IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipes_to_categories l WHERE l.recipe_id = r.id AND l.category_id = #{categoryId}) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
